as_told.title: SAIC remote viewing and crash retrieval

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that SAIC, a large American defence contractor based in Reston, Virginia, has openly studied exotic propulsion, anti-gravity, directed energy weapons and other unusual science, and seems to have worked hand in hand with Stargate, the CIA's psychic spy programme. In another episode he says SAIC took over remote viewing work, the practice of trying to see distant places with the mind, from the CIA, that a former intelligence chief named Bobby Ray Inman sat on its board, and that the company may also have been involved in retrieving crashed UFOs. If true, it would make one private company a hub for the government's strangest research.
